title: Harbinger of Crisis
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought he had finally seized fate by the throat, the gaze from the Heavenly Eye deepened quietly—it saw an interesting piece, moving step by step toward its destined end according to its script.

text.content: The night wind passed through the bamboo grove of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, rustling softly. Su Qingyao's words were like a blunt blade, slowly slicing open a wound in Chen Ji's heart. She spoke calmly, yet every word struck like thunder: the mastermind was hidden among those close to him.

dialogue.content: "Not an outsider." Su Qingyao's voice was extremely low, almost blending with the night wind. "Think about it—who has done the most to promote your 'waste' title over these five years? Who always appears and leaves just when you're being stepped on?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. His fingers tapped lightly against the fan bones hidden in his sleeve—that was the calculation method Mo Xiansheng had taught him. Each tap, and he would run through possible answers in his mind. Five years, someone close, someone with access to the core of the退婚 matter—there couldn't be more than three candidates.

dialogue.content: "I remember." Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice terrifyingly calm. "It's just, Qingyao senior sister, why are you telling me all this?"

text.content: A momentary flicker of turmoil crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, then they returned to their icy clarity: "Because I don't want the internal strife of Tianqing Sect to benefit outsiders." She paused. "Besides... you're no longer entirely an outsider."

Under the moonlight, a trace of warmth—difficult even for Chen Ji himself to察觉—flickered in the depths of his eyes. But soon, he suppressed it, turning to sort through all the gains of this arc. The sphere of influence of Tianji Pavilion, the layout of the imperial court's hidden agents, and... the whereabouts of his sister Chen Ling.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea warmed slightly, and information naturally emerged: the Xuanwu Sect's invasion of Tianqing Sect was directly related to the existence of the Tianji Pavilion ruins. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul left a line of blurry characters in the corner of the fragment: When Heavenly Secrets emerge, the sect shall be severed in two.

choice.prompt: Faced with this series of clues, Chen Ji needed to make a choice: integrate and analyze all the information, or immediately search for his sister Chen Ling?

choices.description: The Tianji Record's information showed the Xuanwu Sect's invasion was related to Tianji Pavilion—this clue must be prioritized
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily set aside the sister's whereabouts
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete picture of the relationship between the Xuanwu Sect and Tianji Pavilion
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity to make contact with the sister

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes in contemplation, fingers drawing out mysterious trajectories in the air. As the deduction deepened, a chilling picture gradually emerged—the Xuanwu Sect's invasion was no coincidence, but an inevitable result of the Tianji Pavilion ruins' opening.

choices.description: The Tianji Record cannot foresee events related to my sister, which means she carries an even greater secret
choices.visible_cost: May miss the true purpose of the Xuanwu Sect's invasion
choices.visible_reward: May obtain clues about Tianji Pavilion from Chen Ling
choices.risk_hint: The secrets on my sister may exceed expectations

text.content: Chen Ji mobilized his Heavenly Fate, attempting to sense his sister's location. However, the Tianji Record's foresight was always blurred regarding her—as if an invisible barrier blocked his probing.

Just then, an unusual fluctuation came from deep within the bamboo grove. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open to see a faint Spiritual Light flickering in the distance—that was Chen Ling's aura, yet not entirely hers alone. There was another presence, ancient and profound, as if from distant antiquity.

dialogue.content: "Brother?" A clear voice came from the Spiritual Light, carrying surprise and delight. "How did you... No, your cultivation level..."}

text.content: Chen Ling's figure stepped out from the Spiritual Light, followed by an elderly figure in a black robe. The elder's face was blurred, as if veiled by mist, yet Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura within that veil—the aura of the Tianji Record.

choice.prompt: Facing the suddenly appearing black-robed elder, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: This elder's aura is similar to the Tianji Record—he must be investigated about his origins
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the source of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The other party's strength is unfathomable

dialogue.content: "Who are you, senior? Why do you carry the aura of the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's voice was neither servile nor overbearing, his gaze fixed directly on the black-robed elder.

text.content: The elder let out a low chuckle: "Interesting. You truly are the one it chose. But do you know? Those chosen by the Tianji Record never meet good ends."

choices.description: Don't reveal myself first, let the other party show their cards first
choices.visible_reward: Make decisions after seeing their true intentions
choices.risk_hint: The elder may also be testing me

text.content: Chen Ji slightly lowered his eyes, suppressing the Tianji Record's aura to its lowest, displaying appropriate surprise and wariness. He was waiting, waiting for the other party to reveal a weakness.

The elder seemed to see through his disguise, yet did not expose it, merely smiling meaningfully: "Truly convincing acting. But child, did you think you were setting the board? In truth, you've always been on someone else's chessboard."

The elder's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, as if assessing something. After a while, he took an ancient token from his sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji: "This is the entry token to Tianji Pavilion. Since you've already been chosen by it, you should at least understand your situation."

The token was ice-cold in his palm, carved with a vertical eye motif that resonated distantly with the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Just then, a faint voice reached Chen Ji's ears—the remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng speaking.

dialogue.content: "Be careful." Mo Xiansheng's voice was more solemn than ever before. "This elder... is a candidate from the previous generation of the Tianji Record. He failed, so he became the gatekeeper. But what he said... child, you've already been marked."

choice.prompt: After obtaining the Tianji Pavilion token, Chen Ji faces a critical choice:

choices.description: Since I've already been marked, I might as well enter Tianji Pavilion and see what they're planning
choices.visible_cost: Officially become a piece on Tianji Pavilion's board
choices.visible_reward: Obtain qualification to enter Tianji Pavilion ruins, unlock more Tianji Record secrets
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into the opponent's trap

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the token into his sleeve, his expression unchanged: "Many thanks for the guidance, senior. It's just that this junior wishes to know—what does Tianji Pavilion require of me?"
The elder's smile deepened: "Smart. What you need to do is very simple—survive the next Heavenly Cataclysm."

choices.description: I won't be anyone's piece, no matter how profound the other party's strength
choices.visible_cost: May lose the opportunity to learn about Tianji Pavilion
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent status, free from Tianji Pavilion's constraints

text.content: Chen Ji tossed the token back to the elder: "This junior is not accustomed to being others' pieces. If senior has matters to discuss, please speak frankly."

The elder caught the token, and the smile vanished from his face, replaced by an indecipherable regret: "What a pity. You're as proud as your father. It's just... proud people often die the earliest."
Just as the atmosphere was about to solidify, Chen Ling suddenly spoke. Her voice carried a tremor, as if suppressing something: "Senior, the Heavenly Cataclysm you mentioned... is it that one?"

The elder's gaze toward Chen Ling softened: "You know?" He seemed surprised, then nodded. "It seems the Holy Sect didn't lie to you. Yes, the Heavenly Eye is about to awaken, and its awakening requires massive amounts of Heavenly Fate as sacrifice."

The Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji silently repeated this name in his heart. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a blinding light, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently in the Mental Sea: "It... why is it so soon..."

The elder seemed to sense something, raising his head toward the night sky. In that profound celestial vault, it was as if an invisible eye was slowly opening, gazing upon everything on the earth. Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill, as if locked upon by an existence beyond comprehension.

dialogue.content: Do you sense it?" The elder's voice echoed in the night wind. "It's been watching all along. From the moment you obtained the Tianji Record, it has been watching. It waits, waits for you to grow stronger, waits for you to accumulate more Heavenly Fate... then, harvests everything at once.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. But he quickly regained composure, even a faint curve appearing at the corner of his lips. Being treated as prey? Fine, then let's see who ends up the hunter in the end.

Just then, a fluctuation from a temporal-spatial rift came from the distance. Chen Ji's heart stirred—that was Chen Tiangming's voice. Following the fluctuation, a coordinate clearly surfaced in his mind: Eastern Sea shore, bottom of the Dragon Abyss, the seventh rift.

The elder seemed to sense that rift too, deeply glancing at Chen Ji: "It seems your fortune has arrived. Remember, child, in this world, there is no such thing as a free gift. Every gain comes with a price."

The black-robed elder's figure gradually blurred, ultimately merging into the night. Chen Ling gazed toward where he disappeared, softly saying: "Brother, what he said is true. The Heavenly Eye... I've also heard of its existence in the Holy Sect."

dialogue.content: "Brother," Chen Ling suddenly gripped Chen Ji's hand, her eyes slightly reddening. "There's something I've never told you. When you obtained the Tianji Record Fragment back then, it wasn't coincidence. Someone deliberately placed it before you. And that person..."

text.content: Chen Ji gently patted his sister's head, interrupting her words: "We'll talk later." His gaze turned to the eastern horizon, where golden light faintly shimmered. Eastern Sea shore, bottom of the Dragon Abyss—that was the next coordinate of destiny.

And in the far reaches of the heavens above, that invisible eye quietly blinked. It saw an interesting piece, moving step by step toward its destined end according to its script—only it did not know that this seemingly weak piece was also secretly weaving its own web.
